newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly higher in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly higher in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed slightly higher on Monday, up 0.16 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 503.37 points, up from 502.57 on Friday.
Volume was 584,739 dinars against 1.38 million dinars over the previous session.
Amen Bank advanced 0.85 dinar to 37.5 dinars. Palm Beach Hotels was up 0.2 to 11. Arab Tunisian Bank rose 0.18 to 32.6 dinars.
Bottler SFBT fell 0.5 to 91.5 dinars. Airline Tunis Air edged down 0.1 dinar to 24. UIB bank declined 0.1 dinar to 13.
